title: When is the strict closure of rings finitely generated?
summary: This paper investigates the finite generation of the strict closure of rings in arbitrary dimension. For a Noetherian local ring $(R, \mathfrak{m})$, we provide a sufficient condition under which the strict closure $R^*$ is finitely generated as an $R$-module. Using this result, we characterize the finite generation of the strict closure over excellent rings.
